named_events.loss_description: The Syndicate's ultimate loss estimate at 31 December 2020 is GBP 71.6m gross and GBP 21.7m net of reinsurance and including reinstatement premiums, primarily in its Accident and Health, Personal Accident Treaty and Credit Risk lines of business.

data.standardized_narrative: The Syndicate's opening gross claims outstanding at 1 January 2020 was GBP 372.186m. During 2020 there was a small overall prior-year release of gross claims provisions of GBP 5.299m (approximately 1.4% of opening gross reserves), as shown in the Technical Provisions movement note. The movement appears to reflect favourable claims development and movements in reinsurance recoverables. The report separately quantifies COVID-19 impact (ultimate gross GBP 71.6m, net GBP 21.7m) concentrated in Accident & Health and treaty/business-credit related portfolios, but this COVID impact is presented as current year estimated losses rather than prior-year strengthening.
raw_causal_phrases: Adverse movements of GBP 1.0 thousand (2019: GBP 18.5 million adverse) in the past year's provision for claims outstanding, net of expected reinsurance recoveries, are included in claims incurred, net of reinsurance.
The current ultimate best estimate financial impact of COVID-19 is GBP 21.7m, net of reinsurance and including reinstatement premiums.

gross_premium_mix.line_of_business: Fire and other damage to property

data.data_quality_notes: Prior-year development (gross) was taken from the Technical Provisions reconciliation row 'Change in prior year provisions' (gross column). The report also contains net prior-year movement commentary and a per-class net table in the Claims note; those net figures were not used for the principal prior-year movement which here is the GROSS amount. No gross, per-line-of-business prior-year movement breakdown was published, so lob-level gross movements are unavailable. Claims triangle is present and was used for cross-checking. No RITC distortion was identified in the Technical Provisions note.
